description: False-colour satellite image of Limni Kiknolakka, an open coastal lagoon in Greece, illustrating the classification of lagoon features within a Natura 2000 site boundary. The image displays a large, dark blue body of "Open water visible in imagery", which corresponds to the "8.3.1 Lagoons (without reeds)" classification. Surrounding the open water, areas of dark green and reddish-brown vegetation are identified as "Reed coverage", correlating to the "8.3.1 Lagoons (with reeds)" classification. A thin green line delineates the "Border of Natura 2000 (N2K) site", encompassing the lagoon and adjacent land areas. The surrounding land shows a mosaic of red (likely agricultural land) and lighter tones (possibly bare ground or built-up areas). No scale bar, compass, or specific date is visible.
